name: aprotel-solar
description: Aprotel Solar monorepo: API, shared contracts, and solar engine.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @aprotel/shared && npm run build -w @aprotel/solar-engine && npm run dev -w @aprotel/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aprotel/shared && npm run build -w @aprotel/solar-engine && npm run build -w @aprotel/api && npm run build -w @aprotel/web && npm run build -w @aprotel/site
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @aprotel/shared && npm run build -w @aprotel/solar-engine && npm run build -w @aprotel/api
scripts.build:site: npm run build -w @aprotel/solar-engine && npm run build -w @aprotel/site
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @aprotel/shared && npm run build -w @aprotel/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aprotel/shared && npm run build -w @aprotel/solar-engine && npm run typecheck -w @aprotel/api && npm run typecheck -w @aprotel/web && npm run typecheck -w @aprotel/site
scripts.admin:bootstrap: npm run build -w @aprotel/shared && npm run admin:bootstrap -w @aprotel/api
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @aprotel/shared && npm run seed -w @aprotel/api
